headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of September 22, 2026, the portfolio set is showing a year-to-date return of 28.92%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 14.13%. This results in an average alpha of 14.79%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', leads with a return of 48.48%, contributing a dollar change of $484.82. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has a return of 11.99%, highlighting a notable disparity in performance among the portfolios. This outperformance relative to SPY is particularly relevant during times of market stress or uncertainty, providing a clearer picture of the portfolio's resilience. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
